task_definition.task_name: First Motion Polarity Classification using DitingMotion on Continuous Waveform

task_description.overview: Automatically determine P-wave first-motion polarity (up or down) on continuous seismic waveforms using a pretrained deep-learning model.
steps: Load the pretrained DiTingMotion model and set it to evaluation mode.
Read continuous waveform data (MiniSEED) using ObsPy.
Extract the vertical component (Z) and compute its first difference (dZ).
Stack Z and dZ into a two-channel input array.
Normalize the stacked data using standard deviation normalization.
Convert the normalized data to a torch tensor and run inference through the model.
Obtain model output probabilities for 'up' and 'down' polarities and select the maximum-probability label.

file_content.predict_polarity: list of int (0 means up, 1 means down)

task_definition.agent_prompt: First motion polarity classification using `ditingmotion` deep learning model on the continuous three-component waveform data. Load and normalize the continuous three-component waveform file at {waveform_path} with the specific {normalize_mode} mode, then use the z-component and its difference (dz) as the model input. The pretrained ditingmotion model is located at {checkpoint_path} and its related parameters are {model_params}. Run inference and save the first motion polarity classification results into a json file {result_data.file_name} with content {result_data.file_content}. Finally, plot a figure to show the waveform with the detected first motion polarity classification results (up or down using arrows pointing) and save it to {waveform_with_polarity}.
